purpose: Full Limbus Company living-world audit queue. Canonicality, narrative use, and timeline placement are independent axes.

policy.canon: A canon-candidate must be rechecked against a current primary or revision-pinned source before release packaging.
policy.narrative: Narrative guidance can shape a Galgame scene but does not by itself change canonicality.
policy.au: AU/IF is an explicit continuity layer, not a bucket for all interactive or roleplay-oriented material.
policy.package: Card-internal anchors remain compact. Audited P0-P4 world packages are independently importable and managed through the optional WTC workbench.

summary.note: Source-index bridge records are provenance pointers, not narrative worldbook content. Use substantiveOnly for coverage claims.
